steps.name: Transform bounded JSON/CSV-style data
steps.script:
import csv, io, json
from pathlib import Path
rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO('name,value\nalpha,2\nbeta,3\n')))
summary = {'count': len(rows), 'total': sum(int(row['value']) for row in rows)}
out = Path('ipad-output')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True))
